data.revised_prompt: Create a game-ready 4 by 4 atlas of seamless top-down greenhouse garden terrain overlay tiles, each tile exactly one quarter of the square canvas. Transparent background outside the overlays. Row 1: damp soil, shallow puddle, wet moss, rain splash. Row 2: yellow-green acid corrosion, bubbling acid stain, cracked corroded soil, runoff streak. Row 3: stone path edge, cyan mossy border, broken garden wall segment, entrance threshold. Row 4: clean transparent variations of small droplets and ground splashes. No text, no UI, no characters, no perspective, orthographic top-down, consistent dark blue-green greenhouse palette, crisp edges, designed to be sliced into individual tile sprites.
